The Quit India Movement was a significant event in India's freedom struggle, and the Prime Minister's tribute highlights its importance.

news_cards.title: Centralised Public Grievance Redress and Monitoring System (CPGRAMS)
bullets: CPGRAMS has transformed public grievance redressal in India through digital innovation and institutional reforms.
No specific numerical data available.
CPGRAMS connects all Central Ministries, Departments, States, and Union Territories through a single platform, enabling timely grievance resolution and promoting accountability.

news_cards.title: Anti-snake venoms to be available in 108 ambulances in A.P.
bullets: The Andhra Pradesh government has decided to make anti-snake venoms available in 108 ambulances across the state.
No specific numerical data available.
The decision has been taken in view of rising emergency calls for snakebite cases, and the anti-snake venoms will ensure immediate and pre-hospital treatments for patients.

news_cards.title: Manipur government announces reopening of National Highways
bullets: The Manipur government has announced the immediate reopening of National Highways for the free movement of people from all communities in the state.
No specific numerical data available.
The government has also announced the resumption of a bus service connecting Manipur's capital Imphal and Nagaland's capital Kohima.

bullets: The Congress high command is likely to appoint four working presidents for the Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee (TPCC).
No specific numerical data available.
The move aims to strengthen the organisation while maintaining a delicate social and political balance.

news_cards.title: El Nino may trigger 39% rainfall deficit this season: Naidu
bullets: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu has flagged the possibility of a 39% deficit in rainfall this season due to the El Niño effect.
The expected rainfall deficit is 39% this season, with August alone likely to record a 56% deficit.
The El Niño effect has also impacted reservoir storage levels, which may affect the state's water supply.

news_cards.title: Mayawati opposes 'creamy layer' for SCs, STs in reservation, hits out at RSS
bullets: BSP supremo Mayawati has opposed the 'creamy layer' concept in reservations for Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.
No specific numerical data available.
Mayawati argued that affirmative action is linked to social transformation, economic emancipation, and self-respect, and criticised the RSS for politicising the issue.
